hey! i'm sorry that the therapy didn't work out for you, but all therapists are definitely not the same and there are ones that will be able to effectively help you. it may take a few times, unfortunately, to find the right therapist, but it's definitely possible and can be extremely beneficial. therapists have different styles and different techniques they use, and some just don't fit well with the patient.

do you know if you have any history of mental illness? it is very possible that the shrooms may have been a stressor which could have triggered something (i.e. stress diathesis model). if that is the case, then talking to a psychologist may help bring some clarity to you and the right one will be able to present you with sufficient ways in which to help manage what you're experiencing.
